visualCharacteristics.purpose: Zillow lender rating summary: live score, star fill, review count and "as of" date from a server-side proxy, next to authored Zillow attribution

contentPattern.structure: optional config row "endpoint" | proxy URL (link or text); optional config row "reviews" | link to the Zillow reviews page; one content row: cell 1 = "How this rating is calculated" link, cell 2 = Zillow logo + copyright line with Terms of Use link. Do NOT author the score, review count or date: they come from the feed. Config rows are removed from the rendered DOM

usage: Live Zillow rating on mortgage pages. Endpoint resolution order: authored "endpoint" (or "feed"/"feed-url"/"source") row, then page metadata "zillow-rating-endpoint", then /placeholders.json key "Zillow Rating Endpoint" (zillowRatingEndpoint). The proxy must hold the Zillow partner key server-side and return JSON { "rating": 4.85, "reviewCount": 4474, "asOf": "2026-10-20", "scale": 5 (optional), "reviewsUrl": "https://..." (optional) }. rating must be 0..scale, reviewCount a non-negative integer, asOf an ISO date. If no endpoint is configured, the request fails or times out (8s), or the data is malformed, the score row is hidden (class rating-summary-unavailable) and the static parts stay. Stars expose role=img with aria-label "Rated X out of 5 stars". Open items: proxy host, Zillow credentials, response caching.
reuseGuidance: Use only for feed-driven rating widgets. Never put an API key in the block or page content.
